title: Iddata Sink
text: Export simulation data as iddata object to MATLAB workspace, 2 inputs; {IDDATA Name} sets the name of iddata and {Sample Time} sets the sample time in seconds. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Input of iddata object scalar | vector

ports.summary: Output of iddata object scalar | vector

params.values: Name of iddata object data (default) | variable name

params.values: Sample time in seconds 0.1 (default) | finite positive number
